articles.title: Commercial LPG price hiked by Rs 10; ATF rates up for fourth straight month
articles.summary: The prices of commercial LPG cylinders have jumped by Rs 10 to reach Rs 2,820, marking a consecutive increase after a rise of Rs 62.50 earlier this month. Additionally, the cost of aviation turbine fuel has escalated by Rs 1.37 per litre, further burdening airline costs.

articles.title: Binance to resume withdrawals after recovering 95% of $6.3 billion crypto theft
articles.summary: Binance has announced a phased resumption of cryptocurrency withdrawals following a significant heist of $6.3 billion. The exchange reported it has recovered 95% of the stolen digital assets, enabling this process.

articles.title: Apple reclaims world's most valuable company title as Nvidia slips amid AI investment concerns
articles.summary: Apple has reclaimed the position of the world's most valuable company, surpassing Nvidia amid rising concerns. Both companies have seen their stock prices decline, with Apple falling 1.2 percent and Nvidia 4.2 percent.

articles.title: BT Explainer | Gold loans surge 83% to ₹5.77 lakh crore: What happens if gold prices fall 15%?

articles.title: Swipe, shop, repeat: Online buyers splash out 7.5% more than offline shoppers
articles.summary: Research indicates that households in India utilizing online shopping platforms incur a monthly expenditure that is 7.5 percent higher than those who do not shop online. Notably, the rise in spending for services and durable goods is strikingly high at 23.4 and 24.5 percent.

articles.title: ‘Binance will absorb impact, not users’: Crypto giant sets aside $6.34 bn to cover losses
articles.summary: Binance has encountered a serious security breach, with $6.3 billion in digital assets being stolen. To safeguard its users, the exchange will utilize its Secure Asset Fund for Users to absorb the losses.

articles.title: Centre scraps Rs 2.5/litre petrol export duty, hikes diesel levy to Rs 11.5
articles.summary: The Centre took significant steps on October 31 by eliminating the Rs 2.5 per litre duty on petrol exports. In contrast, the excise duties for high-speed diesel and aviation turbine fuel were ramped up; diesel duties increased from Rs 8.5 to Rs 11.5 per litre,…

articles.title: 93% drop in Q2 profit despite record sales: Why rising input cost is squeezing IGL
articles.summary: IGL's net profit declined to ₹24.38 crore in Q2 FY27 from ₹372.51 crore in the corresponding quarter last year. The decline came despite an 8% increase in sales volumes and a 26% jump in gross sales turnover, which rose to ₹5,999.13 crore from ₹4,431.63 crore.

articles.title: No more unknown calls! Govt mandates displaying names - here's what changes from November 1
articles.summary: From November 1, telecom operators will implement Calling Name Presentation, changing how incoming calls are displayed. This new feature will show caller names for both saved and unsaved numbers, depending on subscriber details.
